chunks: (And) God said: "We shall strengthen your arm with your brother, and give you power with Our signs and give you authority, so that they will not be able to harm you. Both of you and your followers will be victorious."
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of God's promise to Prophet Hud and Salih in Surah Hud?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a promise of divine empowerment (tashdid) and political authority (sultan) granted to the prophets and their loyal followers to overcome their adversaries. It highlights the concept of 'ghalabah' (victory) not merely as military success but as the triumph of truth over falsehood, reinforcing the Shia belief in the ultimate victory of the righteous under divine guidance.
